The official parcel-centroid locator (-83.1243874, 40.0189535; recomputed by the verifier) and the identity work remain valid for a later admission.
entries.reopen_condition: An in-window dated primary record (City of Hilliard building permit, certificate of occupancy or council record, Franklin County record, or Amazon/AWS statement) that states a construction stage, completion or operation of named data-centre buildings on parcel 050-002806, or an in-window primary announcement of a specific new building or phase on the Scioto Darby Road campus; then admit with that status and the parcel-centroid campus locator.
